custody_amendments.title: Distinguish closed future grants from an already issued ACK
custody_amendments.issue: Closing the runner latch or observing a signal cannot retract a complete ACK the wrapper already validated. A native launch may race cancellation after ACK and before Popen; a filesystem latch read has its own race. The current absolute wording that a closed launch latch means no native Popen is ambiguous between runner and local wrapper state.
custody_amendments.required_selection_text: Closing the runner latch forbids new ACKs. An issued ACK remains a bounded one-shot capability for its already-retained wrapper group until expiry/local cancellation; a launch racing runner cancellation remains custody-owned and is drained. Wrapper-observed signal/error irreversibly closes its local launch path and cannot be reopened by a later ACK. Do not claim zero post-runner-cancel native launches without a separately demonstrated revocation mechanism.
custody_amendments.test_focus: Outer cancellation after durable ACK but before child launch must retain group ownership and fail/clean or preserve scratch honestly, whether child starts or not. This requires no additional service or protocol phase.

custody_amendments.title: Make final spool messages immutable without replacement
custody_amendments.issue: An exclusively created temporary file followed by ordinary rename can replace an existing final path. That publication recipe alone does not establish the stated duplicate/replay rejection or immutable ACK/completion binding.
custody_amendments.required_selection_text: Final publication must refuse an existing destination (or use an equivalent immutable unique message identity with explicit duplicate-state rejection). Never overwrite a prior registration, ACK, completion or exit grant. Journal transition validation must reject duplicate/replayed/conflicting messages and retain every already-proven group. A publication error closes grants and fails/preserves scratch when accounting is incomplete.
custody_amendments.test_focus: Existing destination, duplicate nonce and conflicting same-identity publication must not overwrite prior evidence or obtain another native grant.

custody_amendments.title: Bind phase and selected invocation recipe unambiguously
custody_amendments.issue: The prose requires selected recipe validation, but listed registration/ACK fields have run and invocation nonces without explicit phase or ordinal/recipe identity. Those nonces alone do not state which allowed call they authorize.
custody_amendments.required_selection_text: Add explicit phase plus invocation ordinal/recipe ID to registration/journal/ACK/completion, or define an equally unambiguous private spool and journal binding. Only test phase may request selected OpenSSL work; version and each fixture recipe have finite ordered identities, at most seven one-shot grants. ACK remains bound to full request hash and plan.
custody_amendments.test_focus: Wrong-phase, out-of-order recipe, replayed ordinal and cross-run request receive no new ACK/native grant; prior proven custody is retained.

journal_policy: Complete checked writes and file/directory fsync before acceptance; full completion acceptance before immutable exit grant; strict disk/memory/spool terminal reconciliation required before clean cleanup/result.
